summary: Implemented the Tabs widget feature without running tests or repository code. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (single Text output, click spans appended last); Opacity now merges blended color into existing style, preserving meta; _layout_resolve.py gained a concrete EdgeSpec dataclass satisfying the existing Edge protocol. Tests added: required clickable-range test in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and tests/test_tabs.py. Docs page docs/reference/tabs.md added. Not committed. Judgment calls: bar position stays a full-list index per spec, but the highlight is mapped onto displayed tabs so duplicate names render correctly; empty labels skip the label edge because layout_resolve treats size=0 as flexible; character search only applies to single-character keys; a trailing optional name parameter was added to Tabs; no sandbox demo. Tests have not been executed, so the first run is still pending.
